The '''Monument to Lord Ergast''' was a large monument constructed in the southwestern side of [[Kaas City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] to honor the long-dead [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Ergast]].
